frequency_question: What is the completion rate of complex financial sanction designations from initiation to public implementation within a 35-day or shorter operational window?
membership_rule: Members include formal OFAC designations of major foreign financial institutions involving complex interagency coordination and economic justification; excluded are routine individual or minor entity listings that bypass interagency policy reviews.
provenance_note: 4 cases named, 10 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (2.5x)
coverage_note: 4 named hitting the compressed timeline; 6 required longer multi-month interagency deliberations.
known_gaps: Classified internal Treasury emergency override procedures are not fully captured in public notices.
skeleton: Major financial sanction packages initiated under emergency or expedited interagency timelines (cycles since 2010) times average administrative execution speed relative to a 35-day window.
multiplier: 4 observed expedited major bank designations executed within compressed timelines / 10 total major bank sanction actions evaluated in past decade.
validity_reason: OFAC administrative procedures and interagency review requirements remain stable across administrations.
